title: Progress security advisory (AV26-1031)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1031 Date: October 13, 2026 As of October 12, 2026, Progress is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: MarkLogic Server Prior to 11.3.7 Prior to 12.1.0 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Progress Customer Community Progress Trust Center Article Link: Progress security advisory (AV26-1031) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
